title: 围岩裂隙精准识别与三维模型重构
visual_status: ORIGINAL 71-PAGE PDF ALL-PAGE CONTACT-SHEET AUDIT; pages 53-71 printed Python appendix

problem_data_contract.independent_evaluation_unit: Q1: original borehole image / borehole-depth segment, not pixels or overlapping patches; Q2-Q3: one physical fracture/curve with image provenance; Q4: borehole/fracture network and candidate drilling location
problem_data_contract.input_structure: borehole wall unfolded images plus labels/derived binary masks, fracture geometry, JRC-related contours and six-borehole spatial layout
problem_data_contract.validation_priority: split by original image/borehole/depth block before any patch/tile augmentation; downstream Q2-Q4 validation must propagate upstream segmentation uncertainty
problem_data_contract.author_evaluation_scope: mostly provided attachments and selected figures; no clear independent image/borehole holdout protocol found in the paper

questions.Q1: pixel-level fracture segmentation under rock texture/mud/drilling artifacts
questions.Q2: cluster fracture segments and fit sinusoidal geometry parameters
questions.Q3: extract complex-fracture contour, sample it and estimate JRC roughness
questions.Q4: infer inter-borehole fracture connectivity, reconstruct 3D network, quantify uncertainty and recommend three supplementary boreholes

evidence: original 71-page PDF visually audited on all pages
not_achieved: R3: printed appendix omits/contradicts algorithm-defining components and no complete source/data execution was run
R4-R7: no original-data reproduction or independent transfer of author pipeline

key_strengths: four questions form a coherent segmentation→geometry→roughness→3D decision chain
Q1 compares morphology, U-Net and an improved U-Net rather than reporting one model only
Q2 fixes the sinusoid period to the physical borehole circumference, reducing unnecessary degrees of freedom
Q3 explicitly compares equal-arc-length and curvature-weighted sampling
Q4 visualizes connectivity and uncertainty before drilling recommendation
key_risks: Q1 does not state a defensible train/validation/test independence contract; pixel/patch leakage could inflate metrics
Q1 claimed loss/attention/training-efficiency improvements are not fully mapped to printed code; F1/IoU numbers need aggregation provenance
Q2 prose claims DBSCAN/LM/RANSAC/Huber-style robustness while printed code mainly shows centroid DBSCAN plus plain least_squares; parameters and primitives drift
Q2 contains physically implausible sine amplitudes (e.g. 975.632 mm) without reject/bound rules
Q3 printed appendix bypasses the headline multi-scale LoG/attention path and injects unexplained per-image SCALE_FACTORS before JRC; clipping at 20 causes ceiling saturation
Q3 prose contains a mean JRC around 75 despite later formula/code clipping to 0-20
Q4 connectivity weights/decay scales and uncertainty thresholds are largely hand-set without calibration/sensitivity validation
Q4 second entropy implementation treats histogram density heights as probabilities; AHP is described as pairwise-consistency method but fixed weights are directly assigned
Q4 projection-pursuit GA has identical arithmetic-crossover children, an objective-direction tension in Ddensity, and compares endogenous scores 9.95 vs 8.40 as if they validate drilling quality
Q2 symbol R drifts between full vertical range and half-range sine amplitude; tables/code must use one canonical convention
Q3 curvature-weighted sampler divides segment length by a curvature-increasing weight, which can reverse the stated high-curvature densification intent
Q4 Pjrc prose says geometric mean but the printed equation uses an ambiguous additive expression; connectivity semantics are unresolved
Q4 appendix hard-codes a cyclic-looking borehole adjacency list that conflicts with the 2×3 array/body pair analysis
Q2/Q3 printed code reconstructs masks from JSON annotations rather than Q1 predictions, so downstream results are oracle-intermediate rather than end-to-end evidence
applicable_conditions: borehole/fracture image segmentation with labeled images
periodic fracture traces on cylindrical unfolding
multi-borehole exploratory connectivity analysis when uncertainty is explicitly treated
failure_or_abandon_conditions: independent-image/borehole holdout unavailable for supervised segmentation
fit parameters violate geometric bounds or R²/residual diagnostics fail
JRC calibration constants lack physical/provenance basis
connectivity probabilities cannot be calibrated or sensitivity-tested
drilling ranking is judged only by the score produced by the same optimized weighting rule
recommended_redo: Q1 split by original borehole/image before augmentation; use morphology/U-Net baseline and report IoU/F1 per image/borehole with confidence intervals
Q2 connected components + topology-aware fragment merge + bounded robust sinusoid fit; explicit reject class for non-sinusoidal traces
Q3 use one physically calibrated contour-to-mm mapping, no per-image fudge factor; sensitivity over sampling density and avoid clipping-driven claims

Q4 separate geometric compatibility score from calibrated probability; propagate segmentation/fitting uncertainty via Monte Carlo/bootstrapping and rank drilling sites by expected information gain or robust multi-criteria utility with sensitivity analysis
